hits.about: Elmora Residence Dubai by Neoterra introduces a sophisticated lifestyle destination where luxury, comfort and convenience come together. Nestled in Jumeirah Garden City, the development offers fully furnished studio, one and two-bedroom apartments designed with bespoke finishes, premium branded furniture and smart home technology. With only 85 residences, Elmora delivers an intimate community atmosphere while providing residents with exceptional facilities including an infinity lap pool, business lounge, landscaped gardens, wellness spaces and concierge services. Its central location places Dubai's most iconic landmarks, business districts and entertainment destinations just minutes away.
hits.title: Elmora

hits.about: Flora Bay Residences at Dubai Islands presents a refined waterfront address defined by boutique scale and contemporary coastal design. Rising across nine floors with just 84 residences, the development on Island A, Dubai Islands, offers 1, 2, 3 and 4-bedroom fully furnished apartments crafted for balanced island living.Flora Bay Residences by Centurion Properties combines serene shoreline surroundings with strong capital appreciation potential. A 5% down payment structure, along with lifestyle amenities including a swimming pool, gym, games room, and business centre, enhances both investment value and daily comfort.
hits.title: Flora Bay Residences

hits.about: Norah Residence at JVC is a contemporary residential development designed for refined urban living within a peaceful neighborhood. Located in District 14 of Jumeirah Village Circle, features 183 thoughtfully planned homes, including studio, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments, along with spacious 2 and 3-bedroom duplexes equipped with smart home systems. The units can be booked with a 10% down payment.Norah Residence by Al Tareq Star Real Estate Development blends practical layouts with lifestyle-focused design, supported by amenities such as a swimming pool, gym, outdoor theater, and yoga area. Positioned within JVC, Norah Residence Dubai from strong connectivity and sustained demand, contributing to long-term capital appreciation potential.
hits.title: Norah Residence

bitrix.developer_name: Al Tareq Star Real Estate Development

hits.about: Esplora by BNW Developments is a ready-to-move 20-storey residential tower nestled in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai, one of the city’s fastest-growing communities. Designed to redefine urban sophistication, Esplora blends modern architecture, serene green spaces, and cutting-edge technology across 146 premium apartments, including studios, 1-bedroom, and 2-bedroom layouts.Every detail, from its geometric façade to the Italian marble finishes, embodies comfort, elegance, and quality craftsmanship. With a completion timeline of 2026, this high-rise landmark serves as a testament to refined urban living in the heart of Dubai.
hits.title: Esplora Residences

hits.about: Flora Shore Beachfront Residences at Dubai Islands is a 15-storey project by Calgary Properties, designed by Mimar Architecture + Engineering. It features 76 modern apartments that bring together coastal living and city convenience in one of Dubai’s most attractive island communities.Located on Island A of Dubai Islands, the development offers 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments designed with comfort and space in mind. With strong ROI potential, high-quality finishes, and a range of lifestyle amenities, Flora Shore is ideal for both living and investment.The project features premium amenities such as an infinity swimming pool, an open-air gym, a yoga retreat, an outdoor cinema, co-working spaces, and dedicated kids’ areas, all designed to foster a lifestyle of comfort, leisure, and community. Residents enjoy proximity to key destinations, including the Dubai Marina, Burj Khalifa, and Dubai International Airport, ensuring both accessibility and exclusivity.
hits.title: Flora Shore

hits.about: Binghatti Aurora at JVC is a modern residential development by Binghatti, featuring stylish studio, 1 and 2-bedroom apartments. Nestled in the heart of Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), this project offers a blend of contemporary living and convenience. With thoughtfully designed spaces, it caters to those seeking a home that balances comfort with functionality.The project highlights a lifestyle defined by leisure and accessibility. Surrounded by landscaped green areas and essential amenities, residents enjoy facilities such as a swimming pool and fitness centre. Binghatti Aurora Jumeirah Village Circle stands out with its attractive pricing, prime location, and the strong reputation of Binghatti as a developer, making it a smart choice for investors and end-users alike.
hits.title: Binghatti Aurora

hits.about: Creekside Residence in Al Zorah City redefines waterfront living with its elegant, Mediterranean-inspired architecture and natural surroundings. Located in Al Zorah City, Ajman, and developed by Al Zorah Development Company, this low-rise development features 8 floors of refined residences. It offers 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments each designed to integrate seamlessly with the environment while providing sophisticated living spaces.With serene views of the mangroves, creek, and fairways, Creekside Residence offers more than just homes—it presents a lifestyle rooted in wellness and tranquility. Select amenities such as internal gardens, a multipurpose room, and a state-of-the-art gym enhance the quality of everyday life. Its amphitheater-style layout, sustainable design, and access to premium leisure destinations make it an exceptional choice for discerning homeowners and investors.
hits.title: Creekside Residence

hits.about: Jumeirah Asora Bay by Meraas at La Mer Jumeirah Dubai is a groundbreaking residential project that redefines luxury living, offering a diverse collection of 4  to 7 bedroom residences. The meticulously designed apartments that combine elegant timber patterns and stone finishes with expansive balconies. The crown jewel of Jumeirah Asora Bay by Meraas is the exclusive 7-bedroom penthouse, offering dual-aspect views, double-height entertainment spaces, and an infinity pool, epitomizing the pinnacle of ultra-luxury.Strategically located in Jumeirah, these residences are complemented by world-class amenities, including wellness spas, a residents' lounge, and dining venues that showcase panoramic city and ocean views. Jumeirah Asora Bay combines the tranquility of hidden coves and lush greenery with the vibrant appeal of nearby iconic landmarks, such as Burj Al Arab, Dubai Marina, and Downtown Dubai.
hits.title: Jumeirah Asora Bay

hits.about: Selora Residences at MBR City is a limited-edition gated community by Swank Development, offering an elevated lifestyle in the heart of Dubai. Comprising just 30 luxurious 4, 5 and 6-bedroom villas. Each residence is thoughtfully appointed with private swimming pools, elevators, landscaped gardens, and cutting-edge smart home automation. From outdoor family lounges and BBQ gardens to jogging trails and bespoke interiors, every detail caters to refined living.Swank Development’s Selora Residences blends nature-inspired elemental architecture with contemporary comforts, delivering a sanctuary defined by serenity and sophistication. At the heart of the community lies Laguna Maré – a swimmable crystal lagoon, along with Casa Selora, an elegant clubhouse for social and leisure gatherings. Crafted with premium materials and open-plan layouts, this wellness-focused retreat embraces sustainability while offering a flexible 40/60 payment plan tailored for discerning buyers.
hits.title: Selora Residences

hits.about: Coral Isle Residences at Dubai Islands is an 11-story development by Grovy Real Estate. Featuring a two-year post-handover payment plan, the project introduces a curated collection of 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments—each thoughtfully designed to blend modern elegance, comfort, and functionality. Set within one of Dubai’s most sought-after island destinations, Coral Isle promises a sophisticated living experience by the sea.Residents will enjoy an exceptional array of leisure and wellness amenities from golf simulator and infinity pool, to open pool bar and cabana. Designed for an active and social lifestyle, Coral Isle Residences masterplan also features an outdoor calisthenics gym and jogging tracks. With a flexible payment plan, resort-style amenities, and seamless connectivity, Coral Isle Residences by Grovy presents a prime investment opportunity—if you act fast.
hits.title: Coral Isle Residences

hits.about: Coral Beach Villas by Sobha Realty at Siniya Island is a new luxury benchmark in Umm Al Quwain. It offers stunning 5-bedroom luxury villas. Sobha Coral Beach Villas feature thoughtfully designed layouts with double-height foyers, expansive living spaces, and direct access to private beaches. Coral Beach Villas' location on Siniya Island provides a perfect balance of seclusion and connectivity. Linked to the mainland via a 1.7 km bridge, the island offers peace and easy access to Umm Al Quwain’s key attractions. This prime address ensures residents enjoy tranquil beachfront living without sacrificing urban conveniences.The master plan of Coral Beach Villas includes premium amenities like a fitness center, infinity pool, landscaped parks, and boutique retail spaces. Residents can enjoy exclusive beach activities, jogging tracks, and dining outlets, creating a holistic and enriching lifestyle.
hits.title: Coral Beach Villas

hits.about: Sea Glints Mansions is a limited-edition collection of seven five-bedroom beachfront villas in Al Zorah City. Luxurious residences are located away from the hustle and bustle of the city. The elegant, modern architecture of the villas lives up to the highest standards of design excellence. Each villa has up to 5 bedrooms with bathrooms, built-in wardrobes, ventilation and access to the garden. Individually designed kitchens from European brands boast the highest levels of quality. The master bedroom is decorated in warm tones and features a cozy wood entryway that flows into a walk-in closet. Spacious seafront villas with private gardens and pools offer modern lifestyle and comfort. Immaculately manicured gardens, calming water features and abundant greenery create an oasis of calm for guests and residents. The Clubhouse, located on the golf course, is designed to provide golfers and their guests with the most enjoyable golfing experience possible. With direct access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, Sea Glints Mansions is just 25 minutes from Dubai International Airport, 20 minutes from Sharjah International Airport, 5 minutes from the Medical Center and 35 minutes from the first casino to open in Ras Al Khaimah. This unique place is also easily accessible by boat or yacht, thanks to four modern marinas,which offer convenient year-round parking. Enjoy premium living next to the white sandy beach and bay.
hits.title: Sea Glints Mansions

hits.about: The Coral Collection by Nakheel at Palm Jebel Ali offers an extraordinary living experience with its exclusive 7-bedroom villas. These luxury residences, nestled on the iconic Palm Jebel Ali, combine elegance and tranquility, providing direct access to a private beach. With eight distinct villa types, such as Villa Hibiscus and Villa Ruby Sunset, each home is designed to reflect personal preferences, ensuring comfort and sophistication in every corner.These spacious three-storey villas are adorned with natural elements like wood, marble, and stone, creating a serene atmosphere. Residents will enjoy exclusive amenities, including a private infinity pool, outdoor dining area, and garden, all set against the stunning backdrop of the Dubai skyline. With a flexible payment plan available, The Coral Collection Villas by Nakheel redefines luxury living at Palm Jebel Ali.
hits.title: The Coral Collection

hits.about: Flora Isle at Dubai Islands by Flora Isle Real Estate Development is an upcoming residential project. This exquisite development consists of three towers, built on an expansive plot area of 43,419 square meters. Designed with modern lifestyles in mind, the project offers a combination of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, totaling 251 luxurious units. Flora Isle's well-thought-out features include two passenger elevators and one dedicated service elevator, ensuring seamless vertical transportation for residents and staff.The low-rise buildings boast a diverse range of amenities designed for both indoor and outdoor indulgence. The basement houses premium indoor facilities, ideal for year-round activities and social gatherings. The ground floor provides beautifully landscaped outdoor spaces, offering a tranquil environment for relaxation and recreation. Residents of Flora Isle will enjoy the perfect blend of contemporary living and serene surroundings, making it a coveted address for those seeking comfort and convenience in the heart of Dubai Islands.
hits.title: Flora Isle

hits.about: After the success of Velora 1, Emaar Properties has launched Velora 2. The project at The Valley Phase 2 by Emaar Properties offers 3 and 4-bedroom townhouses in a serene, nature-inspired setting. These homes combine modern design and spacious layouts, featuring large windows that create a seamless indoor-outdoor lifestyle. Velora 2 by Emaar offers a unique real estate investment opportunity with flexible payment plans. In The Valley, Velora 2 by Emaar Properties provides quick access to key areas like Expo 2020, Dubai South, and Jebel Ali.Residents enjoy The Valley Velora Phase 2 amenities, including pools, a fitness center, and nature-themed play areas. This thoughtfully designed master plan blends urban convenience with natural beauty, making Velora 2 in The Valley a perfect choice for families seeking comfort and style. With its strategic location, premium amenities, and elegant design, Velora Phase 2 townhouses offer tranquility and modern living.
hits.title: Velora 2
